items.title: Household account book
items.content: A small ledger of coal, lamp oil and grocery expenses. Several entries are crossed out and rewritten.

items.title: Pharmacy receipt
items.content: A folded receipt for cough syrup and adhesive tape. The ink has faded at the edges.

items.title: Drugstore receipt
items.content: A receipt for aspirin and throat lozenges, folded twice and kept in a coat pocket.

items.title: Milk delivery card
items.content: A household delivery card marked paid through the end of the week.

items.title: Repair estimate
items.content: An estimate for a replacement radio valve. No repair was recorded.

items.title: Rent ledger
items.content: A rent ledger with regular monthly payments and one corrected total.

items.title: Insurance notice
items.content: A routine household insurance notice, folded along the original mailing crease.

items.title: Appliance warranty
items.content: A warranty card for a table fan. The serial number is intact and the guarantee has expired.

items.title: Tailor's receipt
items.content: A receipt for a jacket lining and two replaced buttons. No measurements are included.

items.title: Hardware bill
items.content: A small bill for nails, lamp cord and a replacement latch.

items.title: Utility statement
items.content: A monthly electricity statement showing an ordinary household balance.

items.title: Shoemaker's ticket
items.content: A repair ticket for a pair of work shoes. The collection stamp is smudged.

items.title: Dry cleaner's slip
items.content: A dry-cleaning slip listing one coat and one scarf, both marked collected.

items.title: Bakery account card
items.content: A bakery card with several small purchases entered in pencil.

items.title: Radio service card
items.content: A service card records a routine tuning and a replaced fuse from several months ago.

items.title: Parcel notice
items.content: A postal notice for a parcel already collected. The sender's name is worn away.

items.title: Coal merchant's receipt
items.content: A receipt for one delivery of coal, stamped paid in blue ink.

items.title: Medical appointment card
items.content: An old appointment card for a routine examination. The date has passed.

items.title: Furniture installment stub
items.content: A payment stub for a kitchen table bought on installments. The balance is nearly settled.

items.title: Household inventory sheet
items.content: A handwritten list of crockery, linens and two lamps. Several quantities have been updated.
